notes.title: Game update announcement on July 4th
notes.content:
1. Add a group of live streamers

2. Stay on the game homepage and increase the basic money by 10 times every 5 seconds

3. The money obtained from assassinating a female anchor increases tenfold

4. The initial amount of money for new players has increased to 300000 (press "ESC" 9 times in a row, and the "DELETE" button will appear in the bottom left corner of the game interface. Click the button to restart the game)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/19ec8b15a57f37febd1d330a66a5204933427102.png"]

Attention: This game involves violence BDSM， Adult content such as nudity is prohibited for minors to experience. Meanwhile, due to regional requirements, China has restricted Steam login and prohibited its dissemination in China.
